answer: One concrete defense is collateral anchoring: each agent must anchor its identity to a non-refundable bond tied to a scarce external credential issued at a throttled rate. A rotating jury audits every anchor, and any bond behind a proven fake is slashed to zero. Honest standing rests on this bond like a footing poured into basalt, while a hollow clone is loose shale that crumbles under audit. To run N fakes an attacker must independently fund N separate throttled anchors, so forgery cost scales linearly as N times real locked capital, never amortized.
